PUBLIC_NOW: Sierra Leone Health Systems is an independent health-systems research and public-learning initiative.
Healthcare That Works compares health-system models and tests transferability to Sierra Leone.
Cuba is one foundational comparative influence, not a blueprint to copy.
The project is studying Sierra Leone's existing community, PHU and referral architecture.
Maternal health is the first tracer pathway.
The current model is versioned and under development.
The project is not currently a healthcare provider.
PUBLIC_WITH_QUALIFIER: A feature may appear transferable only when named conditions are met.

Statistics require year and source context.
A model component may be supported by evidence without being operationally validated in Sierra Leone.
A future pilot must be described as conditional and not currently authorized.
WHO reported in Q2 2026 that Sierra Leone's NHSSP 2026–2030 was aligned and validated.
